text:
Omar (PM): Heads-up: customers in support keep asking where invoices live. We need a clearer primary affordance on Usage that scales with orgs. Options: Keep mixed cards + charts, or switch to a single compact ledger with persistent invoice action.
Rae (Design): Compact ledger wins for scanability, but we must avoid hiding the invoice CTA. Idea: persistent top CTA + contextual per-row exports.
Zara (Analytics): Data: users search for 'invoice' in-app ~20% of billing sessions. If CTA moved below fold, search spikes. Keep invoice highly visible.
Chen (Frontend): Technical: persistent CTA is trivial. Per-row download needs proper aria labels and to avoid tab bloat. We'll implement roving tabindex for row actions.
Omar (PM): UX edge: some customers expect PDF invoices for accounting teams; CSVs are for engineers. Should we provide both?
Rae (Design): Provide both: primary "Download invoice (PDF)" and secondary "Download line items (CSV)" per row. Label clearly.
Zara (Analytics): Provide telemetry tags: which format clicked (pdf/csv) and from where (header/row). We'll use this to set defaults.
Chen (Frontend): Accessibility: header CTA needs aria-haspopup if it opens a menu and focus should return to the button after download modal closes.
access-bot: Reminder: add `aria-live="polite"` for scope changes and ensure the PDF link has `role="link"` and descriptive text.
Rae (Design): Token vs currency toggle wording: change to "Display: Tokens / USD" with saved preference hint. Also add a tiny info icon: "Why tokens? -> useful for model-level cost analysis".
Omar (PM): Let's A/B test defaults: A -> tokens default, B -> USD default for billing admins. Run for 2 weeks.
Zara (Analytics): I'll set up experiment and baseline metrics: invoice downloads, export CSV clicks, and support contact rate.
Chen (Frontend): Layout note: add a minimal sparklines column (36px) and make charts adaptive: small multiples when <=5 projects else aggregate. We'll lazy-render to keep initial paint fast.
Rae (Design): Spacing: compact ledger rows at 8px vertical padding. Make per-row icons 24px tappable targets with visible focus ring.
Omar (PM): Copy changes: header CTA: "Download invoice (PDF)"; per-row tooltip: "Download usage CSV". Also show "Latest billed: Apr 2026" under CTA.
Chen (Frontend): For keyboard power-users consider shortcuts: 'd i' to open invoice menu. Will add only if accessible and discoverable in help.
access-bot: Suggestion: include skip link to "Billing actions" landmark for quick navigation.
Omar (PM): Action items: Rae to update mocks, Chen to prototype roving tabindex + lazy sparklines, Zara to configure A/B, and I'll update PRD. Review in 24 hours.
Rae (Design): Will post Figma frames and an accessibility checklist.
Omar (PM): Thanks all, resolving thread.
